requirements: R1: Resolve backend container database connection or Flyway initialization failure.
R2: Fix backup container volume mount so backup.sh is a file instead of a directory.

slices.title: Repair Docker Compose runtime environment issues
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime repair for this epic, I want to fix the container configurations, so that the application successfully starts and passes health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh deployment via docker-compose,
When the containers are initialized,
Then the backend successfully connects to the database and passes health checks,
And automated QA verification confirms backup.sh runs without directory mount errors.
